title: Repository-wide admin control DB contract governance

phases.objective: Prevent caller/provider DB-control contract mismatches from reaching runtime by establishing one canonical manifest, a governed shared builder, a repository-wide raw-caller ratchet, CI enforcement, and explicit fail-closed policy while retaining the focused Migration 1043 caller repair.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository contributor changing an operational DB-control caller
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: CI passes only when the provider, canonical manifest, shared builder, and all governed operational callers agree on tool=db, action=run, and sql; new raw callers, legacy aliases, provider compatibility aliases, or an expanded legacy raw-caller allowlist fail closed before merge.
steps: Load the canonical admin-control DB contract manifest.
Verify the runtime provider still defaults to and permits only action=run and reads SQL from body.sql.
Verify the provider retains unsupported_db_action and db_sql_required fail-closed errors and does not accept legacy query aliases.
Load the shared request builder and prove it emits the canonical tool, action, and SQL field without a legacy alias.
Scan all JavaScript operational callers under .github/ops for raw tool=db payloads.
Reject any new raw caller that is not in the migration-only legacy allowlist and require the shared builder instead.
Validate every allowlisted raw caller still uses action=run and sql.
On CI, compare the legacy allowlist to the base branch and reject additions so the ratchet may only shrink.
Run the DB governance phase first inside the shell-free Node test orchestrator, before the canonical test manifest.
Run self-tests proving action=query, query-as-SQL-field, and missing action are rejected.
Run the Migration 1043 Apply contract test to retain the exact caller repair and no-retry safety boundary.
assertions: The canonical contract is stored at .github/contracts/admin-control-db.v1.json and declares /admin/control, tool=db, action=run, and sql_field=sql.
New raw operational DB callers are forbidden; the shared builder is the required path for new callers.
The legacy raw-caller allowlist is a monotonic ratchet that may only shrink relative to the base branch.
The provider must not gain compatibility handling for action=query or body.query to repair a caller mismatch.
npm test remains a single shell-free Node orchestrator command; the governance phase executes first with --ci and fails closed before the canonical test manifest.
Migration 1043 continues to use the canonical action=run and sql shape and retains its exact-once/readback/no-retry controls.
No database migration, provider call, credential payload read, external business write, deployment, Production ref mutation, or secret evidence occurs during policy validation.

phases.objective: Migrate legacy raw operational DB callers to the shared builder and remove their allowlist entries without increasing the ratchet.
Expand static detection to any additional executable language or generated operational surface that can address /admin/control.
Require zero legacy raw DB callers and retain only manifest-plus-builder construction for governed operational DB control.
